name: Argan Rael
otherStatistics: AC 18 with Mage Armor. Saving throws Con +4, Int +10, Wis +3. Arcana +10, History +10, Investigation +10, Perception +3. Resists fire and necrotic damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Speaks Common and Infernal.
description: Argan persuaded Prince Ellan to fund his hunt for immortality. He now lives in the Bracers of the Spellbreaker and prefers to take spellcasters as hosts.

sections.Printed source: p. 382. Soulbinder items and curse, pp. 380–381.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. Argan has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Pervasive Magic. His spell attacks bypass damage resistance.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Arcane Lance attacks.
Arcane Lance (cantrip). Melee or ranged spell attack +10, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one target. Hit 17 (5d6) force damage. Argan can move the target horizontally up to 15 ft.
Lightning Volley (3rd-level spell). Choose up to three visible creatures within 30 ft. Each makes a DC 18 Constitution save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) lightning damage and halves speed until the end of its next turn. Success halves damage and leaves speed alone.
Fireball (1/day, 7th-level spell). Pick a point within 90 ft. Chosen creatures in a 20-ft.-radius sphere make DC 18 Dexterity saves, taking 42 (12d6) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions: Misty Step (2/day, 2nd-level spell). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.
sections.Utility Spells: Intelligence, spell save DC 18. All listed utility spells take one action. At will, Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Message, Prestidigitation. Twice per day each, Detect Magic, Mage Armor, Sending.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Soulbinders. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order. The member taking it must be present and able to act.
Action 4, Gravity Bomb. Center a 20-ft.-radius sphere on a visible point within 90 ft. Enemies inside make DC 18 Constitution saves. A failure deals 33 (6d10) force damage and reduces speed to 0 through the end of the target's next turn. Success halves the damage and preserves speed.
sections.Recoverable Magic Item:
Bracers of the Spellbreaker. Very rare. Spellcaster attunement required. The wearer has advantage on saves against spells and magical effects, and their spell attacks bypass damage resistance.
Cursed Sentience. The item uses its Soulbinder's alignment, mental ability scores, and languages. It hears and sees in darkness within 60 ft. and can speak to its wearer telepathically. Break attunement with Remove Curse or equivalent magic. After seven days attuned and every 24 hours after that, make a DC 18 Wisdom save. Each failure reduces Wisdom by 1 while attuned. On the third failure, the Soulbinder takes control and changes the wearer's body, statistics, and equipment to match its own. The wearer remains aware. Breaking attunement restores the body and control. The Soulbinder returns to the item when attunement ends or the body dies. After 1d6 + 12 months of possession, the victim's soul and body are destroyed. The full group ritual for permanently lifting the curse is on p. 382.

name: Kishina Darrowind
otherStatistics: Armor includes Pathfinder’s Boots. Saving throws Str +5, Dex +10, Wis +10. Acrobatics +10, Athletics +5, Insight +10, Perception +10. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 20. Speaks Common and Elvish.
description: Kishina once fought the invaders of her homeland. She guided the Soulbinders to the ruin that bound her to the Pathfinder’s Boots, and now wants to learn how the ritual worked.

sections.Printed source: p. 383. Villain party action, p. 382. Soulbinder items and curse, pp. 380–381.

Throwing Knife. Ranged weapon attack +10, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d4 + 7) piercing damage.
Painful Sprint (recharge 6). Move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each enemy Kishina can see and passes within 5 ft. of makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure it is Poisoned until the start of its next turn. If it fails by at least 5, it also falls Prone.
sections.Bonus Actions: Throw. A visible Large or smaller enemy within 5 ft. makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. On a failure, Kishina moves the target up to 15 ft. away and knocks it Prone.
sections.Reactions: Shield (3/day, 1st-level spell). When an attack or Magic Missile targets Kishina, she gains +5 AC including against that attack and takes no Magic Missile damage until the start of her next turn.
sections.Villain Party Action:

name: Prince Ellan Farra
otherStatistics: Breastplate and shield. Saving throws Dex +5, Wis +10, Cha +8. Deception +8, Insight +10, Persuasion +8, Religion +3. Immune to psychic damage and to Charmed and Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 17. Speaks Common and Elvish.

Approach makes the target advance by the shortest route and end its turn when within 5 ft. Drop makes it release held objects and end its turn. Flee makes it spend its turn getting away as quickly as possible. Grovel makes it fall Prone and end its turn. Halt forbids movement and actions.
Unholy Flame (3rd-level spell). A visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 27 (6d8) fire damage and envelops the creature in flame. While enveloped it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of its turns and can save to end the effect at the end of each turn. Success on the initial save halves the damage and avoids the ongoing flames.

name: Radlee Thugram
otherStatistics: Plate. Saving throws Str +10, Con +5, Wis +6. Athletics +10, Intimidation +4, Perception +6, Survival +6. Truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 16. Speaks Common.

name: Scarlet Shadow
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Saving throws Dex +10, Int +4, Wis +8. Acrobatics +10, Perception +8, Sleight of Hand +10, Stealth +13. Resists necrotic damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 18. Speaks Common and Draconic.

Sneak Attack (1/turn). A weapon hit deals 14 (4d6) extra damage if he has advantage. It also qualifies when an ally who can act is within 5 ft. of the target and Scarlet lacks disadvantage.
sections.Actions:

Longbow. Ranged weapon attack +10, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing damage.

Umbral Breath (recharge 6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make DC 18 Dexterity saves. A failure deals 28 (8d6) necrotic damage and leaves the creature Frightened of Scarlet for 1 minute, with a repeat save at the end of each turn. Success halves damage and avoids Frightened.

name: Jutkarr Flintfingers
otherStatistics: Breastplate. Saving throws Con +5, Int +9. History +9, Investigation +9, Perception +6, Religion +9. Resists poison and psychic damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16. Speaks Common, Dwarvish, and thieves’ cant. Telepathy 120 ft.
description: Jutkarr likes locks and guarded vaults for the same reason he likes the broadsheet’s puzzles. He plans the Amethyst Knife’s operations and keeps its supplies in order.

sections.Traits:
Mind Link. The bosses of the Amethyst Knife can speak telepathically with one another across any distance on the same plane.
Poison Resistant. Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Deserved Transfer attacks.
Deserved Transfer (2nd-order power). Melee or ranged power attack +9, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) psychic damage. A creature Jutkarr can see within 30 ft. gains temporary HP equal to half the damage dealt.
Psionic Resilience (2/day, 4th-order power). Touch a willing creature and give it immunity to one chosen condition for 1 hour. Choose Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, or Stunned. Suppress that condition for the same duration if the target already has it.
sections.Reactions: Shared Condition. When the creature becomes Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned, it can transfer the condition and its remaining duration to a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 ft. who neither has the condition nor is immune to it. The condition ends for the original creature. This reaction works even while Incapacitated.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Amethyst Knife. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order. The member taking it must be present and able to act.
Action 3, I Planned For This. An Amethyst Knife boss within 60 ft. of Jutkarr can swap places by teleporting with another willing boss in the same area. A boss must see the one it swaps with. No action required.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): While Dazed, a creature can use only one of its movement, action, or bonus action on its turn. Gaining Dazed ends the turn if it happens during that turn. Extra actions such as Haste or Action Surge still work. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can end the condition.
sections.Psionic Powers (MCDM): Powers have no components and count as supernatural. Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic do not stop powers. A creature may maintain several different powers at once, up to its proficiency bonus, but cannot concentrate on a spell or another effect at the same time. Failing a concentration save ends all active powers. If a foe provokes an opportunity attack, the creature can use a melee power attack as its reaction instead.

name: Kiona the Dread Lord
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Int +9, Wis +6. Arcana +9, History +9, Perception +6. description: The Codex Mortis destroyed the archaeologist Kiona Duemois’s body. She built an army of spectral undead to search for the lost book.

Rise from Death (1/day). Summon three shadows, two specters, or one wraith under Kiona's control. They appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 ft. and act immediately after her on the same initiative count.
sections.Bonus Actions: Path of Pain. An incorporeal Undead other than Kiona within 120 ft. who can see her can move up to its speed.
sections.Reactions: Death’s Breath. After hitting Kiona with an attack from within 5 ft., the attacker must make a DC 17 Constitution save or be Poisoned through the end of its next turn.
sections.Villain Actions:
Kiona can use one of these actions after an enemy's turn, up to once per round. Each is available once per encounter, in any order.
Action 1, Restrain Them! Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each enemy in a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered there makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. Failure leaves it Restrained until the end of Kiona's next turn.
Action 2, Ruinous March. Kiona and each ally within 60 ft. can move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Action 3, Vitality Drain. Kiona and each ally within 60 ft. can make a melee attack without using an action. A creature hit gains one level of Exhaustion.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): Magical and psionic attacks deal supernatural damage and bypass the listed resistance to mundane attacks.
